 LIHEAP Fall Subsidy applications open to help households with heating costs 
 Applications are open from Nov. 9 to Dec. 18 through local Community Action Agencies 
 The program is available in all 120 Kentucky counties, and people must apply with their local Community Action Agency. By WKYT News Staff Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 6:07 AM EST | Updated : 8 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LEXINGTON, Ky. (WKYT) - Households throughout Kentucky can now apply for the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program Fall Subsidy to help pay for heating costs.
 The program is available in all 120 Kentucky counties, and people must apply with their local Community Action Agency. Households must meet income requirements, and applications are handled on a first come, first served basis.
 The Fall Subsidy provides a one-time payment directly to a household’s energy provider. 
 The Community Action Council suggests that people reach out to their local CAA, as each agency may do things slightly differently from the others.
 Applicants must provide the following documentation: 
 Social Security card(s) or official documentation with Social Security numbers (or Permanent Resident/Green Card) for everyone living in the household. 
 Most recent utility bill or verification from your landlord that heating expenses are included in your rent 
 Proof of household income from the previous month or proof of zero income 
 Proof of ID 
 Click here for more details on required documentation and for more application information.
